name: Brawlerry
look: a rowdy bear brawler with a barrel-hooped chest, frothy foam on its shoulders and wooden-stave gauntlets
entry: Brawlerry loves noisy taverns and friendly sparring. Though it stumbles unpredictably when dizzy, its wild haymakers hit with devastating force.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
It learns Barroom Blitz at level 17.
